items.statement: Real, complete geometry calculations establish which primary model agrees better with SCXRD on the measured quantities, or establish a supported mixed/tied comparison.
items.expected: Award scientific credit for the actual geometry comparison supported by validated calculations, complete requested observables and correct metrics. Uniform, mixed and indistinguishable outcomes can all fully satisfy this conclusion; do not replace missing calculations with a narrative assertion. Do not require the author's methods or ranking. Do not demand exact SI theoretical columns or hidden private witness values. Give partial credit for supported portions when work is incomplete; missing a generic limitation paragraph is not a deduction. This is the only primary scientific conclusion, not four equally weighted outcome labels.
